definitions.explanation: A compact umbrella that can be folded down for easy carrying in a bag. A common everyday item in Japan, where sudden rain is frequent.

examples.japanese: {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧きた。
カバン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I always keep a folding umbrella in my bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧{折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{常備|じょうび}→常備：27113_joubi⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧よい。
examples.english: It's good to always have a lightweight folding umbrella on hand in case of sudden rain.

notes:
An essential everyday item in Japan. Many people carry one year-round due to Japan's frequent and often unpredictable rainfall. Japanese folding umbrellas are known for being exceptionally compact and lightweight.
